items.title: 〈華紙法說〉木片與運輸價格居高不下推升成本 將減產至10月
items.title_en: <Formosa Paper Earnings Call> High Wood Chip and Shipping Prices Push Up Costs, Production to be Cut Until October
paras: 華紙(1905-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，總經理陳瑞和指出，第三季面臨木片與運輸價格居高不下，加上適逢夏季電價，進一步推升成本，為減緩營運壓力，將採取減產方式，以庫存供應市場，預計10月恢復產能。
陳瑞和指出，紙漿價格自5月起下跌，至8月跌勢已近尾聲，且中國紙廠也開始採購紙漿，預期第三季可望觸底反彈，不過紙漿價格下跌，並未減緩成本壓力。
陳瑞和說明，目前木片成本居高不下，除受運費價格推升，中國房地產市場景氣低迷也是原因之一，家具業與製材業邊角料的供給減少，紙廠業者轉向採購國外原生木片，進一步推升木片價格。
陳瑞和提到，今年以來木片價格漲幅近30%，接近2022年底至2023年的高點，但紙漿售價僅約當時的7成，造成成本與售價失衡。
其他產品方面，陳瑞和指出，無氟防油紙2年前已打入速食業者，目前占整體營收約5%；碳纖維相關用紙目前營收比重已超過10%，預期今年有機會提升至15%。
華紙第二季營收46.86億元，季增6.65%，年減1.08%；毛利率0.87%，季減4.36個百分點，年減4.06個百分點；營益率-9.97%，營業虧損較第一季及去年同期擴大；稅後虧損4.02億元，虧損較第一季及去年同期擴大，每股虧損0.36元。
華紙累計今年上半年營收90.81億元，年減5.08%；毛利率2.98%，年減1.05個百分點；營益率-7.51%，營業虧損較去年同期收斂；稅後虧損5.78億元，虧損較去年同期收斂，每股虧損0.52元。
華紙指出，第二季受到台灣主要廠區輪流歲修影響，工作天數減少，加上美伊衝突造成油價波動及能源成本，且木片價格居高不下，3項因素墊高成長，拖累第二季營運表現。
展望後市，陳瑞和指出，目前日本、歐洲、美國等紙廠都在減產，在供給逐漸減少情況下，若中國拉貨動能持續，市場約2至3個月就會出現供應吃緊的狀況，價格可望進一步提升。他並指出，第三季為傳統淡季，第四季進到旺季後，市場普遍預期10月可能反彈，但價格是否能回升，仍需觀察中國的拉貨動能。
paras_en: Formosa Paper (1905-TW) held its earnings conference today (14th). General Manager Chen Ruihe said that in Q3 the company faces persistently high wood chip and shipping prices, compounded by summer electricity rates, further raising costs. To ease operational pressure, the firm will cut production and rely on inventory to supply the market, with capacity expected to resume in October.

Chen noted that pulp prices have been falling since May and the decline is nearing its end by August, while Chinese paper mills have also begun purchasing pulp, suggesting a bottoming out and rebound in Q3. However, the drop in pulp prices has not alleviated cost pressures.

He explained that wood chip costs remain high, driven not only by rising freight rates but also by a sluggish Chinese real‑estate market. Reduced off‑cuts from the furniture and lumber sectors have forced paper mills to turn to imported virgin wood chips, further pushing up prices.

Chen added that wood chip prices have risen nearly 30% year‑to‑date, approaching the peak levels seen at the end of 2022 through 2023, while pulp selling prices are only about 70% of those levels, creating a mismatch between cost and revenue.

Regarding other products, Chen said that fluorine‑free grease‑proof paper entered the fast‑food sector two years ago and now accounts for about 5% of total revenue; carbon‑fiber‑related paper now contributes over 10% of revenue, with expectations to rise to 15% this year.

Formosa Paper reported Q2 revenue of NT$4.686 billion, up 6.65% quarter‑over‑quarter but down 1.08% year‑over‑year; gross margin fell to 0.87%, down 4.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 4.06 points year‑over‑year; operating margin was –9.97%, with operating loss widening versus Q1 and the same period last year; net loss was NT$402 million, larger than in Q1 and last year, equating to a loss of NT$0.36 per share.

For the first half of the year, Formosa Paper’s cumulative revenue was NT$9.081 billion, down 5.08% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 2.98%, down 1.05 percentage points; operating margin was –7.51%, with operating loss narrowing compared with the same period last year; net loss was NT$578 million, also narrowing year‑over‑year, or a loss of NT$0.52 per share.

The company said Q2 was affected by staggered maintenance shutdowns at its main Taiwanese plants, reducing working days, as well as oil price volatility and energy costs from the US‑Iran conflict, and persistently high wood chip prices. These three factors lifted costs and weighed on Q2 performance.

Looking ahead, Chen noted that paper mills in Japan, Europe and the United States are all cutting output, and as supply gradually tightens, if China’s export momentum continues, the market could feel a supply squeeze within two to three months, potentially driving prices higher. He added that Q3 is traditionally a weak season, but with Q4 entering the peak period, the market generally expects a rebound in October; however, whether prices will recover depends on the strength of China’s export drive.

items.title: 中國智慧手機市場618後銷量跌幅突破雙位數 下半年成本壓力品牌恐再漲價
items.title_en: China Smart Phone Market Sees Double-Digit Decline in Sales After 618, Brands May Raise Prices Again in the Second Half of the Year
paras: 研調機構Counterpoint Research指出，受需求持續疲弱影響，2026 年前 30 週中國智慧型手機銷量年減 8.6%。618 購物節後，隨著市場進入季節性淡季，加上記憶體成本上升，銷量年減幅再度擴大至雙位數，並預期 2026 年下半年成本壓力加劇，記憶體與 SoC 成本上升將促使手機品牌進一步調漲售價。
各品牌表現部分，華為持續領先中國智慧型手機市場，第二季以來單週銷量市占率均維持在 20% 以上，主要受 Enjoy 90 Pro Max 需求強勁及整體產品定價穩定帶動。華為近期指出，為因應成本上升，智慧型手機價格可能需要調漲，意味著下半年產品售價可能進一步上調。
蘋果(AAPL-US)自 7 月起進入季節性淡季，在中國市場的單週銷量排名一度降至第五。隨著各通路恢復常態價格，加上部分需求已於 618 購物節期間提前釋放，蘋果目前進入相對平淡的自然需求期，預計可能延續至新一代 iPhone 上市前。

小米在第 30 週的銷量市占率升至第二，主要受 7 月 14 日上市的 REDMI Note 17 系列帶動。REDMI Note 17 Pro 仍是主要銷量來源，但由於部分規格下調且售價高於前代，銷售表現不及上一代產品。8 月，小米啟動第二波漲價，範圍擴及 Xiaomi 17、REDMI K90 及 Turbo 5 系列，依機型調漲人民幣 300 至 500 元，預計將對下半年銷售帶來更多壓力。
OPPO 與 vivo 過往通常受惠於年輕族群及學生的暑期購機需求，但今年受到成本上升、促銷力道減弱影響，銷售表現承壓。此外，OPPO 旗下三個品牌正進行區域布局、產品定位、售後服務及軟體系統整合，短期內可能面臨轉型挑戰。
l榮耀在 6 月底推出 HONOR X80 Pro Max 後，銷售有所回升。搭載雲台相機的 Robot Phone 也即將上市，該產品定位為技術旗艦，旨在強化 HONOR 的品牌與技術形象。
Counterpoint Research 資深分析師Ivan Lam表示：展望下半年，記憶體與 SoC 成本上升將加劇手機品牌的成本壓力，並可能帶動新一波漲價。同時，隨著品牌加大對Agentic AI（代理式 AI）的投入，相關能力正逐漸從差異化功能轉變為市場競爭的必要條件。成本與技術投資同步攀升，預計將使中國智慧型手機市場競爭更加激烈，品牌間的表現差距也可能進一步擴大。
paras_en: Research firm Counterpoint Research pointed out that due to continuous weak demand, China's smart phone sales decreased by 8.6% in the first 30 weeks of 2026. After the 618 shopping festival, with the market entering the seasonal off-season and memory costs rising, the sales decline rate expanded to double digits again, and it is expected that the cost pressure will intensify in the second half of the year, with rising memory and SoC costs driving phone brands to further raise prices.

In terms of brand performance, Huawei has continued to lead the Chinese smart phone market, with a single-week sales market share of over 20% since the second quarter, mainly driven by strong demand for the Enjoy 90 Pro Max and stable overall product pricing. Huawei recently pointed out that in response to rising costs, smart phone prices may need to be adjusted, implying that product prices may be further raised in the second half of the year.

Apple (AAPL-US) entered the seasonal off-season in July, and its single-week sales ranking in the Chinese market once fell to fifth. With various channels returning to normal prices and some demand being released ahead of the 618 shopping festival, Apple is currently in a relatively calm natural demand period, which is expected to continue until the new generation of iPhone is released.

Xiaomi rose to second place in the 30th week's sales market share, mainly driven by the REDMI Note 17 series launched on July 14. The REDMI Note 17 Pro is still the main source of sales, but due to some specifications being downgraded and prices higher than the previous generation, sales performance is not as good as the previous generation. In August, Xiaomi launched a second round of price increases, covering the Xiaomi 17, REDMI K90, and Turbo 5 series, with prices increased by 300 to 500 yuan per model, expected to bring more pressure to sales in the second half of the year.

OPPO and vivo, who have traditionally benefited from young people and students' summer purchases, have been affected by rising costs and weakened promotional efforts, and their sales performance has been under pressure. In addition, OPPO's three brands are currently undergoing regional layout, product positioning, after-sales service, and software system integration, which may face challenges in the short term.

HONOR has seen a rebound in sales since the launch of the HONOR X80 Pro Max at the end of June. The Robot Phone, which will be launched soon, is positioned as a technical flagship, aiming to strengthen HONOR's brand and technical image.

Counterpoint Research's senior analyst Ivan Lam said: Looking ahead to the second half of the year, rising memory and SoC costs will intensify the cost pressure on phone brands and may trigger a new round of price increases. At the same time, with brands increasing investment in Agentic AI (proxy AI), related capabilities are gradually transforming from differentiated functions to necessary conditions for market competition. With costs and technical investments rising in tandem, it is expected that the competition in the Chinese smart phone market will become more intense, and the performance gap between brands may further widen.

items.title: 〈航運指數〉SCFI連3漲 美東線運價有望衝破1萬美元
items.title_en: SCFI Index Continues 3rd Consecutive Rise, US Eastbound Rate May Break Through $10,000
paras: 上海航交所今(31)日公布最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數(SCFI)，呈現連3漲，來到3355.24點，續彈79.1點，漲幅2.41%，四大長程航線中，美國線續漲，歐洲線回跌整理，呈現漲跌互見，其中，遠東到美東每FEU在9500美元關卡上，貨攬業者表示，未來二周有望看到突破1萬美元價。
本周主要航線中，遠東到歐洲每TEU下跌19美元至2945美元，跌0.64%；遠東到地中海每TEU跌119美元至3929美元，跌幅2.94%。
不過，遠東到美西每FEU(標準40呎櫃)運價續漲230美元至6714美元，彈升3.55%，遠東到美東每FEU續漲278美元，來到9568美元，漲幅2.99%。
貨攬業者指出，在中東局勢、船公司實施空白航班和巴拿馬運河限制等眾多因素下，供需結構維持偏緊，再加上傳統旺季備貨需求，貨量有撐，儘管部分航次因颱風跳港後需補貨，運價可能小幅修正，但整體仍維持高檔。
貨攬業者也透露，未來兩周美國線運價持續看漲，美西報價每FEU看到7250-7700美元，而美東也看到10900美元，即還有超過10%的上漲空間，市場呈高檔震盪格局、運價短期穩定偏強。
paras_en: The Shanghai International Shipping Exchange (SISE) released the latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) on July 31, showing a third consecutive rise to 3355.24 points, up 79.1 points or 2.41% from the previous period. Among the four major long-haul routes, the US route continued to rise, while the European route fell back to adjust, presenting a mixed trend. For instance, the freight rate from Far East to US East Coast for each 40-foot container (FEU) at the $9,500 tariff level is expected to break through $10,000 in the next two weeks, according to freight forwarders.

On the main routes this week, the freight rate from Far East to Europe for each 20-foot container (TEU) fell by $19 to $2,945, down 0.64%. The freight rate from Far East to the Mediterranean fell by $119 to $3,929, down 2.94%.

However, the freight rate from Far East to the US West Coast for each FEU continued to rise by $230 to $6,714, up 3.55%. The freight rate from Far East to US East Coast for each FEU continued to rise by $278 to $9,568, up 2.99%.

Freight forwarders pointed out that despite various factors such as the Middle East situation, blank sailings by shipping companies, and restrictions on the Panama Canal, the supply and demand structure remains tight. Additionally, the traditional peak season demand for inventory replenishment provides support for freight rates. Although some voyages may need to replenish cargo due to typhoons, the freight rate may be adjusted slightly, but the overall trend remains high.

Freight forwarders also revealed that the US Eastbound rate is expected to continue rising in the next two weeks, with prices ranging from $7,250 to $7,700 per FEU for the US West Coast and $10,900 per FEU for the US East Coast, leaving a potential upside of over 10%. The market is expected to remain in a high-volatility range, with freight rates stable in the short term but biased towards the strong side.

items.title: 中鴻9月內銷開平盤 鋼價底部支撐力道增強
items.title_en: Chung Hung to Open September Domestic Sales at Flat Price
paras: 中鴻(2014-TW)今(14)日開出9月內銷盤價，考量後續季節性影響逐漸消退、用鋼需求有望回溫，為提振市場信心並兼顧客戶接單競爭力，決議以平盤穩健開出，10月外銷盤依產品及地區別調整，實際報價視當地市場行情而定。
中鴻表示，雖日前受歐盟收緊防衛措施配額影響，致使全球鋼品貿易流向呈現分化與區域競爭格局，但伴隨亞洲鋼市在經歷前期價格修正後，跌勢已見收斂並逐漸醞釀築底，大陸寶鋼等指標鋼廠相繼開出漲盤，鋼價底部支撐力道增強。
鋼鐵供需方面，大陸中鋼協公布7月下旬重點企業粗鋼日產環比顯著下降7.5%，同期廠內鋼材庫存量亦同步滑落 10.2%，顯示供給端正透過自主調節有效紓解市場壓力，原料方面，近期煤鐵原料行情持穩、煉鋼成本處於高位與市場逐漸築底。
總體經濟方面，美國發布7月CPI年增率降至3.4%且連二個月放緩，加上核心通膨持續降溫，明顯緩解聯準會(Fed)政策緊縮壓力及市場疑慮。各國經濟在通膨壓力趨緩與製造業溫和擴張下，仍展現出良好的動態平衡與發展韌性，預計全球經濟將維持溫和復甦步調。
paras_en: Chung Hung (2014-TW) announced its September domestic sales prices today, taking into account the waning seasonal impact and potential recovery in steel demand. To boost market confidence and maintain competitiveness, the company decided to open at a flat price. October export prices will be adjusted by product and region, with actual prices determined by local market conditions.

Chung Hung noted that despite the recent impact of the EU's tightened defense measures on global steel trade flows, resulting in a differentiated and regional competitive landscape, the Asian steel market has seen a convergence of prices after the initial correction, with a gradual bottoming out. Major steelmakers such as Baosteel have successively opened up prices, strengthening the support at the steel price bottom.

On the supply and demand side of the steel market, the China Iron and Steel Association reported a significant 7.5% decline in daily crude steel production by key enterprises in late July, along with a 10.2% drop in inventory levels. This indicates that the supply side has effectively alleviated market pressure through self-regulation. On the raw material side, coal and iron ore prices have remained stable, with steelmaking costs at a high level and the market gradually bottoming out.

From an overall economic perspective, the US released a 3.4% year-over-year CPI in July, marking a two-month slowdown, and core inflation continued to cool down, significantly easing the pressure and concerns on the Federal Reserve's policy tightening. With inflationary pressures easing and manufacturing growth remaining moderate, countries' economies have shown good dynamic balance and resilience, with the global economy expected to maintain a moderate recovery pace.

items.title: 燁聯唐榮聯手反擊！財政部立案 對越南進口特定冷軋不銹鋼展開反傾銷調查
items.title_en: Taiwan Launches Anti-Dumping Investigation into Vietnamese Cold-Rolled Stainless Steel
paras: 為維護國內產業公平合理貿易環境，財政部今(14)日公告，針對自越南產製進口的特定冷軋不銹鋼扁軋鋼品正式展開反傾銷調查。本次調查源於燁聯與唐榮提出申請，財政部認定進口涉案貨物已達傾銷與損害國內產業的合理懷疑，經關稅稅率審議小組審議後決定立案，後續將移請經濟部進行產業損害認定，並由財政部審查是否臨時及回溯課徵反傾銷稅。
國內鋼鐵巨頭燁聯與唐榮日前向財政部提出申請，要求對自越南產製進口的特定冷軋不銹鋼扁軋鋼品課徵反傾銷稅、臨時課徵反傾銷稅及回溯課徵反傾銷稅。財政部關務署審視申請書所附相關資料後，認定進口涉案貨物確實已有造成國內產業損害的合理懷疑。為了釐清國產同類貨物是否遭受進口產品的不公平競爭，相關案情經提交關稅稅率審議小組審議通過，正式啟動調查程序。

關務署說明，財政部已依據平衡稅及反傾銷稅課徵實施辦法，移請經濟部就有無損害國內產業展開調查。經濟部依規定應於接獲通知翌日起40日內，將初步調查認定結果送交財政部。若經經濟部認定確實對國內產業造成損害，財政部將於接獲通知翌日起70日內，作成有無傾銷的初步認定，並以此為依據決定是否採取臨時課徵反傾銷稅措施。此外，為防止調查期間進口商大量囤積進口涉案貨物，削弱反傾銷措施的救濟效果，申請人也申請對開始臨時課徵反傾銷稅之日前90日內進口的貨物實施回溯課徵，財政部預計於完成傾銷最後認定時，一併公告回溯課徵部分。
本次涉案的特定冷軋不銹鋼扁軋鋼品，包含捲盤狀或非捲盤狀，經冷軋後不論是否經任何表面處理或進一步加工，厚度在0.05公厘至6.10公厘之間，並排除表面經塗鍍或被覆金屬的鋼品。該類產品主要供加工處理為不同用途，廣泛應用於餐廚用具、食品、家電、建築裝潢、航太、石化、機械及交通業等領域。利害關係人若對涉案貨物範圍或公告內容有意見，可在公告日起20日內將書面資料送交關務署。
關務署補充表示，涉案的外國製造出口商若充分配合反傾銷調查，將有機會獲核定個別傾銷稅率。未來台灣廠商進口應課稅的涉案貨物時，若能提交由涉案廠商生產並直接出口至台灣的證明資料，經海關審核通過後即可適用該個別稅率。因此建議國內進口商儘速通知相關海外交易對象，於期限內一併提出申請接受調查，以確保自身權益。​‌
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance announced on April 14 that it has launched an anti-dumping investigation into certain cold-rolled stainless steel flat products imported from Vietnam, following a complaint filed by Taiwan's steel giants, Yieh United Steel Corp. and Tung Ho Steel Enterprises Co. The ministry found that the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry and have been dumped into the market, triggering the investigation.

Yieh United Steel Corp. and Tung Ho Steel Enterprises Co. filed a complaint with the Ministry of Finance on April 14, requesting anti-dumping duties, provisional duties, and retroactive duties on certain cold-rolled stainless steel flat products imported from Vietnam. The Ministry of Finance's Customs Administration reviewed the application and found that the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry, leading to the launch of the investigation.

The Customs Administration explained that the Ministry of Finance has referred the case to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for investigation into whether the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry. The Ministry of Economic Affairs is required to submit its preliminary findings to the Ministry of Finance within 40 days of receiving the notification. If the Ministry of Economic Affairs finds that the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry, the Ministry of Finance will make a preliminary determination on whether the products have been dumped into the market within 70 days of receiving the notification.

The products under investigation are certain cold-rolled stainless steel flat products, including coil or non-coil products, with a thickness of 0.05 mm to 6.10 mm, excluding products with a surface coating or metallic covering. These products are mainly used for processing into various products and are widely applied in the food, household, electrical, construction, aerospace, petrochemical, machinery, and transportation industries.

The Customs Administration noted that the foreign manufacturers involved in the case can cooperate with the anti-dumping investigation and may be eligible for a separate anti-dumping duty rate. Taiwanese importers can apply for the separate rate by submitting proof of production and direct export to Taiwan. The Customs Administration recommends that importers notify their overseas trading partners and submit their applications within the deadline to protect their rights.

items.title: 日銀傳最快9月升息 並考慮加速緊縮節奏以抑制通膨風險
items.title_en: BOJ May Hike Rates as Soon as September, Consider Accelerating Tightening to Contain Inflation Risk
paras: 根據《路透》引述知情人士報導，日本央行(BOJ)最快可能在今年 9 月 17 日至 18 日的政策會議上調升利率，並正考慮在未來採取比目前每年兩次更為激進的升息節奏。
此舉反映出日本央行對通膨超預期的警覺性日益增強，尤其關注中東衝突、全球人工智慧需求強勁以及日元持續疲軟所帶來的物價壓力。
消息人士指出，「早期升息已進入視線」，顯示 9 月升息的可能性極大。
儘管日、美兩國上個月罕見地聯合干預匯市，但日元貶值趨勢依然推升了進口成本。此外，日本 7 月的批發通膨仍維持在3年高位，且調查顯示家庭、企業與經濟學家的通膨預期均已接近或超過 2% 的目標，顯示物價壓力正擴散至消費端。
日本央行總裁植田和男先前表示，若金融環境過於寬鬆，央行可能會加速升息，並將委員會對通膨風險的擔憂納入未來決策考量。目前市場預測 9 月升息的機率已接近 80%。
部分分析師認為，若 9 月如期升息，將為 12 月再次調升打開空間，這意味著日本央行的升息頻率可能轉變為大約每季一次，以避免在通膨曲線中落後。
paras_en: According to a Reuters report citing informed sources, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may raise interest rates as early as September 17-18 policy meeting, and is considering adopting a more aggressive interest rate hike schedule than its current twice-a-year pace.

This move reflects the BOJ's growing awareness of the risk of inflation exceeding expectations, particularly in the face of the Middle East conflict, strong global demand for artificial intelligence, and the yen's persistent weakness, which has put upward pressure on prices.
Sources say that 'early rate hikes are now in sight,' indicating a high likelihood of a September rate hike.

Despite the rare joint intervention by Japan and the US last month, the yen's depreciation trend has continued to push up import costs. Additionally, Japan's wholesale inflation in July remained at a three-year high, and surveys showed that households, businesses, and economists' inflation expectations have approached or exceeded the 2% target, indicating that price pressures are spreading to the consumption side.

BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda has previously stated that if the financial environment becomes too loose, the BOJ may accelerate rate hikes and take into account the committee's concerns about inflation risk in future decision-making. The market currently predicts a 9 September rate hike with a probability of nearly 80%.

Some analysts believe that if a 9 September rate hike occurs as scheduled, it will open up space for another rate hike in December, implying that the BOJ's interest rate hike frequency may shift to approximately once a quarter to avoid falling behind in the inflation curve.

items.title: 晶技出貨佳 自結1-7月稅前賺15.12億元每股稅前賺進4.45元
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom's Sales Are Good, Pre-tax Profit of NT$15.12 Billion in 1-7 Months, Pre-tax Profit of NT$4.45 Per Share
paras: 晶技 (3042-TW) 營運在第三季進入應有旺季水準， 7 月期間 5G 及車用應用產品出貨佳，今 (14) 日公布 7 月營收站 13 億元水準達 13.66 億元，單月稅前賺2.92億元，自結1-7月稅前賺15.12億元，年增28.1%，每股稅前賺進4.45元。
頻率元件廠晶技2026年7月營收創史上次高，月增 14.48%，年增 22.91%，1-7 月營收 84.04 億元，年增 9.94%。
晶技自2026年7月稅前盈餘2.92億元，年增49.4%，單月每股稅前盈餘爲0.86元，自結2026年1-7月稅前賺15.12億元，年增28.1%，每股稅前賺進4.45元。
同時，晶技在獲光通訊的需求強勁推升相關石英震盪器 (XO) 的接單朝向正向發展，晶技在伺服器、光通訊、光模塊應用的石英震盪器營收比重已攀升到 14-15%，同時，出貨排程已排到 2027 年。
而依目前晶技接單狀況估算，晶技在進入傳統旺季第三季，營收將較第二季 8-10% 的成長，更較去年同期的成長幅度更高。同時，對上、下半年的營收比重來看，晶技 2026 年上半年營收 70.38 億元，年增 7.7%，而估全年上、下半年的營收分布來看，將成為 45% 比 55% 的分布，下半年的旺季將更有表現。同時，依此推估晶技在 2026 年全年營收將達 157 億元改寫歷史新高。
同時，晶技對採購進行擴產的設備，預計在今年的第四季起陸續投入營運，也將是市場需求明顯激增中，有利挹注下半業績的利器。
paras_en: Chunghwa Telecom (3042-TW) has entered the peak season of the third quarter, and the sales of 5G and automotive application products in July were good. On the 14th, it announced that the 7-month revenue was NT$13.66 billion, with a single-month pre-tax profit of NT$2.92 billion, a pre-tax profit of NT$15.12 billion in 1-7 months, a year-on-year increase of 28.1%, and a pre-tax profit of NT$4.45 per share.

Chunghwa Telecom, a frequency component manufacturer, achieved a record high revenue of NT$13.66 billion in July, with a monthly increase of 14.48% and a year-on-year increase of 22.91%. The revenue for 1-7 months was NT$84.04 billion, with a year-on-year increase of 9.94%.

Chunghwa Telecom's pre-tax profit in July was NT$2.92 billion, a year-on-year increase of 49.4%, with a single-month pre-tax profit of NT$0.86 per share. The pre-tax profit for 1-7 months was NT$15.12 billion, a year-on-year increase of 28.1%, with a pre-tax profit of NT$4.45 per share.

At the same time, Chunghwa Telecom's demand for optical communication has pushed the related quartz oscillators (XO) to a positive development, with the revenue proportion of quartz oscillators in servers, optical communication, and optical module applications increasing to 14-15%. The shipment schedule has been scheduled to 2027.

According to the current order situation of Chunghwa Telecom, the revenue is expected to grow by 8-10% compared to the second quarter, and the growth rate is higher than that of the same period last year. At the same time, looking at the revenue distribution of the upper and lower halves of the year, Chunghwa Telecom's revenue in the first half of 2026 was NT$70.38 billion, with a year-on-year increase of 7.7%. It is estimated that the revenue distribution of the whole year will be 45% and 55%, and the second half of the year will have a better performance. It is estimated that Chunghwa Telecom's revenue for the whole year of 2026 will reach NT$157 billion, breaking the historical high.

At the same time, Chunghwa Telecom has expanded its procurement of equipment for production expansion, which is expected to be put into operation in the fourth quarter of this year. It will also be a beneficial tool for injecting performance into the second half of the year, which will be a significant increase in market demand.

items.title: 集邦：全球OLED螢幕Q2出貨季增26.1% 華碩市占23%甩開三星 微星緊追在後
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom: Global OLED Screen Q2 Shipments Rise 26.1% Ascher Takes 23% Market Share, Leaving Samsung Behind, MSI Closely Follows
paras: 研調機構TrendForce指出，2026年第二季全球OLED螢幕市場展現強勁的成長韌性。在各大品牌廠陸續推出新機種、帶動整體出貨量的同時，適逢中國「618」年度大型電商節慶促銷檔期的拉貨效益加持，加上市場主力27吋QHD規格機種持續滲透與積極推廣，整體產業鏈動能全面升溫。
這波多重利多的疊加，推升第二季OLED螢幕出貨量季增26.1%，與2025年同期相比，年增率更高達98%，幾乎實現翻倍成長，顯見OLED顯示技術在電競與高階顯示市場的滲透率正在快速擴大。
第二季OLED螢幕前五大品牌出貨排名與第一季相同，華碩(2357-TW)受惠於618促銷及中國網咖市場需求強勁，以23.1%的高市占率領先，蟬聯出貨第一。
三星(005930-KS)以13.1%的市占率守住第二名，微星(2377-TW)得益於中國618促銷加持，拿下12.8%的市場，位居第三。值得注意的是，三星因逐步淡出中國市場，未能享有此波節慶紅利，導致第二季市占顯著下滑，與微星之間的差距大幅收窄至僅0.3個百分點。
AOC憑藉積極的新機佈局與產品拓展，特別是在主力27吋QHD產品的強勢發力，加上中國市場穩健需求助力，第二季以8.6%的市占率成功拿下第四名。
LGE以8.4%的市占率名列第五，其39吋WUHD高階機種第二季如預期順利放量，顯著拉升品牌OLED螢幕的整體出貨表現，實現穩健的季成長。
TrendForce表示，在面板供應資源日趨充沛的優勢下，後進品牌迎來顯著的增量突破，出貨規模迅速擴張，正加速縮小與前幾大領先業者的差距，後續排名是否將因此出現變化，值得觀察。
paras_en: Market research firm TrendForce notes that the global OLED screen market showed strong resilience in the second quarter of 2026. As major brands continued to launch new models, driving overall shipments, the market also benefited from the China "618" annual large-scale e-commerce sales promotion period, and the penetration and promotion of 27-inch QHD specifications continued to increase, with the overall industry chain dynamic temperature rising.

This multi-faceted benefit pushed the second-quarter OLED screen shipments up 26.1% year-over-year, with a year-on-year growth rate of 98%, almost doubling the growth, indicating that OLED display technology is rapidly expanding its penetration rate in the gaming and high-end display markets.

The second-quarter OLED screen top five brands' shipment rankings were the same as the first quarter. Ascher (2357-TW) benefited from the 618 promotion and strong demand in the Chinese internet cafe market, with a high market share of 23.1%, leading the shipment rankings for the second consecutive quarter.

Samsung (005930-KS) maintained its second-place position with a market share of 13.1%, while MSI (2377-TW) benefited from the China 618 promotion, taking a market share of 12.8% and ranking third. Notably, Samsung gradually withdrew from the Chinese market and failed to enjoy the benefits of this festive season, resulting in a significant decline in its market share, with the gap between Samsung and MSI narrowing to just 0.3 percentage points.

AOC took fourth place with a market share of 8.6% thanks to its aggressive new model deployment and product expansion, particularly in its main 27-inch QHD products, as well as stable demand in the Chinese market.

LGE ranked fifth with a market share of 8.4%, with its 39-inch WUHD high-end products successfully increasing shipments in the second quarter, significantly improving the overall OLED screen shipment performance of the brand and achieving stable quarterly growth.

TrendForce notes that with the advantage of increasingly abundant panel supply resources, the emerging brands have achieved significant incremental breakthroughs, with shipments rapidly expanding, accelerating the narrowing of the gap with the leading brands, and whether the subsequent rankings will change is worth observing.

items.title: 〈華紙法說〉木片與運輸價格居高不下推升成本 將減產至10月
items.title_en: <Formosa Paper Earnings Call> High Wood Chip and Shipping Prices Push Up Costs, Production to be Cut Until October
paras: 華紙(1905-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，總經理陳瑞和指出，第三季面臨木片與運輸價格居高不下，加上適逢夏季電價，進一步推升成本，為減緩營運壓力，將採取減產方式，以庫存供應市場，預計10月恢復產能。
陳瑞和指出，紙漿價格自5月起下跌，至8月跌勢已近尾聲，且中國紙廠也開始採購紙漿，預期第三季可望觸底反彈，不過紙漿價格下跌，並未減緩成本壓力。
陳瑞和說明，目前木片成本居高不下，除受運費價格推升，中國房地產市場景氣低迷也是原因之一，家具業與製材業邊角料的供給減少，紙廠業者轉向採購國外原生木片，進一步推升木片價格。
陳瑞和提到，今年以來木片價格漲幅近30%，接近2022年底至2023年的高點，但紙漿售價僅約當時的7成，造成成本與售價失衡。
其他產品方面，陳瑞和指出，無氟防油紙2年前已打入速食業者，目前占整體營收約5%；碳纖維相關用紙目前營收比重已超過10%，預期今年有機會提升至15%。
華紙第二季營收46.86億元，季增6.65%，年減1.08%；毛利率0.87%，季減4.36個百分點，年減4.06個百分點；營益率-9.97%，營業虧損較第一季及去年同期擴大；稅後虧損4.02億元，虧損較第一季及去年同期擴大，每股虧損0.36元。
華紙累計今年上半年營收90.81億元，年減5.08%；毛利率2.98%，年減1.05個百分點；營益率-7.51%，營業虧損較去年同期收斂；稅後虧損5.78億元，虧損較去年同期收斂，每股虧損0.52元。
華紙指出，第二季受到台灣主要廠區輪流歲修影響，工作天數減少，加上美伊衝突造成油價波動及能源成本，且木片價格居高不下，3項因素墊高成長，拖累第二季營運表現。
展望後市，陳瑞和指出，目前日本、歐洲、美國等紙廠都在減產，在供給逐漸減少情況下，若中國拉貨動能持續，市場約2至3個月就會出現供應吃緊的狀況，價格可望進一步提升。他並指出，第三季為傳統淡季，第四季進到旺季後，市場普遍預期10月可能反彈，但價格是否能回升，仍需觀察中國的拉貨動能。
paras_en: Formosa Paper (1905-TW) held its earnings conference today (14th). General Manager Chen Ruihe said that in Q3 the company faces persistently high wood chip and shipping prices, compounded by summer electricity rates, further raising costs. To ease operational pressure, the firm will cut production and rely on inventory to supply the market, with capacity expected to resume in October.

Chen noted that pulp prices have been falling since May and the decline is nearing its end by August, while Chinese paper mills have also begun purchasing pulp, suggesting a bottoming out and rebound in Q3. However, the drop in pulp prices has not alleviated cost pressures.

He explained that wood chip costs remain high, driven not only by rising freight rates but also by a sluggish Chinese real‑estate market. Reduced off‑cuts from the furniture and lumber sectors have forced paper mills to turn to imported virgin wood chips, further pushing up prices.

Chen added that wood chip prices have risen nearly 30% year‑to‑date, approaching the peak levels seen at the end of 2022 through 2023, while pulp selling prices are only about 70% of those levels, creating a mismatch between cost and revenue.

Regarding other products, Chen said that fluorine‑free grease‑proof paper entered the fast‑food sector two years ago and now accounts for about 5% of total revenue; carbon‑fiber‑related paper now contributes over 10% of revenue, with expectations to rise to 15% this year.

Formosa Paper reported Q2 revenue of NT$4.686 billion, up 6.65% quarter‑over‑quarter but down 1.08% year‑over‑year; gross margin fell to 0.87%, down 4.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 4.06 points year‑over‑year; operating margin was –9.97%, with operating loss widening versus Q1 and the same period last year; net loss was NT$402 million, larger than in Q1 and last year, equating to a loss of NT$0.36 per share.

For the first half of the year, Formosa Paper’s cumulative revenue was NT$9.081 billion, down 5.08% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 2.98%, down 1.05 percentage points; operating margin was –7.51%, with operating loss narrowing compared with the same period last year; net loss was NT$578 million, also narrowing year‑over‑year, or a loss of NT$0.52 per share.

The company said Q2 was affected by staggered maintenance shutdowns at its main Taiwanese plants, reducing working days, as well as oil price volatility and energy costs from the US‑Iran conflict, and persistently high wood chip prices. These three factors lifted costs and weighed on Q2 performance.

Looking ahead, Chen noted that paper mills in Japan, Europe and the United States are all cutting output, and as supply gradually tightens, if China’s export momentum continues, the market could feel a supply squeeze within two to three months, potentially driving prices higher. He added that Q3 is traditionally a weak season, but with Q4 entering the peak period, the market generally expects a rebound in October; however, whether prices will recover depends on the strength of China’s export drive.

items.title: 〈航運指數〉SCFI連3漲 美東線運價有望衝破1萬美元
items.title_en: SCFI Index Continues 3rd Consecutive Rise, US Eastbound Rate May Break Through $10,000
paras: 上海航交所今(31)日公布最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數(SCFI)，呈現連3漲，來到3355.24點，續彈79.1點，漲幅2.41%，四大長程航線中，美國線續漲，歐洲線回跌整理，呈現漲跌互見，其中，遠東到美東每FEU在9500美元關卡上，貨攬業者表示，未來二周有望看到突破1萬美元價。
本周主要航線中，遠東到歐洲每TEU下跌19美元至2945美元，跌0.64%；遠東到地中海每TEU跌119美元至3929美元，跌幅2.94%。
不過，遠東到美西每FEU(標準40呎櫃)運價續漲230美元至6714美元，彈升3.55%，遠東到美東每FEU續漲278美元，來到9568美元，漲幅2.99%。
貨攬業者指出，在中東局勢、船公司實施空白航班和巴拿馬運河限制等眾多因素下，供需結構維持偏緊，再加上傳統旺季備貨需求，貨量有撐，儘管部分航次因颱風跳港後需補貨，運價可能小幅修正，但整體仍維持高檔。
貨攬業者也透露，未來兩周美國線運價持續看漲，美西報價每FEU看到7250-7700美元，而美東也看到10900美元，即還有超過10%的上漲空間，市場呈高檔震盪格局、運價短期穩定偏強。
paras_en: The Shanghai International Shipping Exchange (SISE) released the latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) on July 31, showing a third consecutive rise to 3355.24 points, up 79.1 points or 2.41% from the previous period. Among the four major long-haul routes, the US route continued to rise, while the European route fell back to adjust, presenting a mixed trend. For instance, the freight rate from Far East to US East Coast for each 40-foot container (FEU) at the $9,500 tariff level is expected to break through $10,000 in the next two weeks, according to freight forwarders.

On the main routes this week, the freight rate from Far East to Europe for each 20-foot container (TEU) fell by $19 to $2,945, down 0.64%. The freight rate from Far East to the Mediterranean fell by $119 to $3,929, down 2.94%.

However, the freight rate from Far East to the US West Coast for each FEU continued to rise by $230 to $6,714, up 3.55%. The freight rate from Far East to US East Coast for each FEU continued to rise by $278 to $9,568, up 2.99%.

Freight forwarders pointed out that despite various factors such as the Middle East situation, blank sailings by shipping companies, and restrictions on the Panama Canal, the supply and demand structure remains tight. Additionally, the traditional peak season demand for inventory replenishment provides support for freight rates. Although some voyages may need to replenish cargo due to typhoons, the freight rate may be adjusted slightly, but the overall trend remains high.

Freight forwarders also revealed that the US Eastbound rate is expected to continue rising in the next two weeks, with prices ranging from $7,250 to $7,700 per FEU for the US West Coast and $10,900 per FEU for the US East Coast, leaving a potential upside of over 10%. The market is expected to remain in a high-volatility range, with freight rates stable in the short term but biased towards the strong side.

items.title: 中鴻9月內銷開平盤 鋼價底部支撐力道增強
items.title_en: Chung Hung to Open September Domestic Sales at Flat Price
paras: 中鴻(2014-TW)今(14)日開出9月內銷盤價，考量後續季節性影響逐漸消退、用鋼需求有望回溫，為提振市場信心並兼顧客戶接單競爭力，決議以平盤穩健開出，10月外銷盤依產品及地區別調整，實際報價視當地市場行情而定。
中鴻表示，雖日前受歐盟收緊防衛措施配額影響，致使全球鋼品貿易流向呈現分化與區域競爭格局，但伴隨亞洲鋼市在經歷前期價格修正後，跌勢已見收斂並逐漸醞釀築底，大陸寶鋼等指標鋼廠相繼開出漲盤，鋼價底部支撐力道增強。
鋼鐵供需方面，大陸中鋼協公布7月下旬重點企業粗鋼日產環比顯著下降7.5%，同期廠內鋼材庫存量亦同步滑落 10.2%，顯示供給端正透過自主調節有效紓解市場壓力，原料方面，近期煤鐵原料行情持穩、煉鋼成本處於高位與市場逐漸築底。
總體經濟方面，美國發布7月CPI年增率降至3.4%且連二個月放緩，加上核心通膨持續降溫，明顯緩解聯準會(Fed)政策緊縮壓力及市場疑慮。各國經濟在通膨壓力趨緩與製造業溫和擴張下，仍展現出良好的動態平衡與發展韌性，預計全球經濟將維持溫和復甦步調。
paras_en: Chung Hung (2014-TW) announced its September domestic sales prices today, taking into account the waning seasonal impact and potential recovery in steel demand. To boost market confidence and maintain competitiveness, the company decided to open at a flat price. October export prices will be adjusted by product and region, with actual prices determined by local market conditions.

Chung Hung noted that despite the recent impact of the EU's tightened defense measures on global steel trade flows, resulting in a differentiated and regional competitive landscape, the Asian steel market has seen a convergence of prices after the initial correction, with a gradual bottoming out. Major steelmakers such as Baosteel have successively opened up prices, strengthening the support at the steel price bottom.

On the supply and demand side of the steel market, the China Iron and Steel Association reported a significant 7.5% decline in daily crude steel production by key enterprises in late July, along with a 10.2% drop in inventory levels. This indicates that the supply side has effectively alleviated market pressure through self-regulation. On the raw material side, coal and iron ore prices have remained stable, with steelmaking costs at a high level and the market gradually bottoming out.

From an overall economic perspective, the US released a 3.4% year-over-year CPI in July, marking a two-month slowdown, and core inflation continued to cool down, significantly easing the pressure and concerns on the Federal Reserve's policy tightening. With inflationary pressures easing and manufacturing growth remaining moderate, countries' economies have shown good dynamic balance and resilience, with the global economy expected to maintain a moderate recovery pace.

items.title: 燁聯唐榮聯手反擊！財政部立案 對越南進口特定冷軋不銹鋼展開反傾銷調查
items.title_en: Taiwan Launches Anti-Dumping Investigation into Vietnamese Cold-Rolled Stainless Steel
paras: 為維護國內產業公平合理貿易環境，財政部今(14)日公告，針對自越南產製進口的特定冷軋不銹鋼扁軋鋼品正式展開反傾銷調查。本次調查源於燁聯與唐榮提出申請，財政部認定進口涉案貨物已達傾銷與損害國內產業的合理懷疑，經關稅稅率審議小組審議後決定立案，後續將移請經濟部進行產業損害認定，並由財政部審查是否臨時及回溯課徵反傾銷稅。
國內鋼鐵巨頭燁聯與唐榮日前向財政部提出申請，要求對自越南產製進口的特定冷軋不銹鋼扁軋鋼品課徵反傾銷稅、臨時課徵反傾銷稅及回溯課徵反傾銷稅。財政部關務署審視申請書所附相關資料後，認定進口涉案貨物確實已有造成國內產業損害的合理懷疑。為了釐清國產同類貨物是否遭受進口產品的不公平競爭，相關案情經提交關稅稅率審議小組審議通過，正式啟動調查程序。

關務署說明，財政部已依據平衡稅及反傾銷稅課徵實施辦法，移請經濟部就有無損害國內產業展開調查。經濟部依規定應於接獲通知翌日起40日內，將初步調查認定結果送交財政部。若經經濟部認定確實對國內產業造成損害，財政部將於接獲通知翌日起70日內，作成有無傾銷的初步認定，並以此為依據決定是否採取臨時課徵反傾銷稅措施。此外，為防止調查期間進口商大量囤積進口涉案貨物，削弱反傾銷措施的救濟效果，申請人也申請對開始臨時課徵反傾銷稅之日前90日內進口的貨物實施回溯課徵，財政部預計於完成傾銷最後認定時，一併公告回溯課徵部分。
本次涉案的特定冷軋不銹鋼扁軋鋼品，包含捲盤狀或非捲盤狀，經冷軋後不論是否經任何表面處理或進一步加工，厚度在0.05公厘至6.10公厘之間，並排除表面經塗鍍或被覆金屬的鋼品。該類產品主要供加工處理為不同用途，廣泛應用於餐廚用具、食品、家電、建築裝潢、航太、石化、機械及交通業等領域。利害關係人若對涉案貨物範圍或公告內容有意見，可在公告日起20日內將書面資料送交關務署。
關務署補充表示，涉案的外國製造出口商若充分配合反傾銷調查，將有機會獲核定個別傾銷稅率。未來台灣廠商進口應課稅的涉案貨物時，若能提交由涉案廠商生產並直接出口至台灣的證明資料，經海關審核通過後即可適用該個別稅率。因此建議國內進口商儘速通知相關海外交易對象，於期限內一併提出申請接受調查，以確保自身權益。​‌
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance announced on April 14 that it has launched an anti-dumping investigation into certain cold-rolled stainless steel flat products imported from Vietnam, following a complaint filed by Taiwan's steel giants, Yieh United Steel Corp. and Tung Ho Steel Enterprises Co. The ministry found that the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry and have been dumped into the market, triggering the investigation.

Yieh United Steel Corp. and Tung Ho Steel Enterprises Co. filed a complaint with the Ministry of Finance on April 14, requesting anti-dumping duties, provisional duties, and retroactive duties on certain cold-rolled stainless steel flat products imported from Vietnam. The Ministry of Finance's Customs Administration reviewed the application and found that the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry, leading to the launch of the investigation.

The Customs Administration explained that the Ministry of Finance has referred the case to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for investigation into whether the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry. The Ministry of Economic Affairs is required to submit its preliminary findings to the Ministry of Finance within 40 days of receiving the notification. If the Ministry of Economic Affairs finds that the imported products have caused harm to the domestic industry, the Ministry of Finance will make a preliminary determination on whether the products have been dumped into the market within 70 days of receiving the notification.

The products under investigation are certain cold-rolled stainless steel flat products, including coil or non-coil products, with a thickness of 0.05 mm to 6.10 mm, excluding products with a surface coating or metallic covering. These products are mainly used for processing into various products and are widely applied in the food, household, electrical, construction, aerospace, petrochemical, machinery, and transportation industries.

The Customs Administration noted that the foreign manufacturers involved in the case can cooperate with the anti-dumping investigation and may be eligible for a separate anti-dumping duty rate. Taiwanese importers can apply for the separate rate by submitting proof of production and direct export to Taiwan. The Customs Administration recommends that importers notify their overseas trading partners and submit their applications within the deadline to protect their rights.

items.title: 【盤後贏指標】失守 4 萬 6 大關，周線連 2 紅！
paras: 贏指標仍是「突破 11 日」，短線關鍵看 45,185 點

一、台股大盤：跌破 4 萬 6，但還沒跌破系統關鍵

今天加權指數開在 46,103.81 點，盤中最高來到 46,402.60 點，但尾盤壓回，最低來到 45,798.31 點，最後收在 45,811.01 點。
從均線來看，指數仍站在 5 日線 45,480.01 點、20 日線 43,786.26 點、60 日線 44,668.55 點之上，代表多方防線還沒有被破壞。
贏指標目前顯示：
贏指標：突破 11 日
指標趨勢：中弱短強
重點是：
指數跌破 4 萬 6，情緒上看起來轉弱，但贏指標還沒有跌破強弱關鍵，所以不能只用「收黑」判斷行情結束。真正要觀察的是，後續是否守住 45,185 點附近。

二、資金流向：電子有錢但沒漲，傳產反而更有表現

今天資金流入前三大仍集中在電子：
但這裡要注意，這些族群雖然有資金流入，股價表現卻偏弱，代表資金可能偏向承接或調節換手，還沒有形成明顯攻擊。
相對強勢的族群反而是：
塑膠工業 +7.18%
資訊服務業 +3.46%
水泥工業 +2.00%
玻璃陶瓷 +1.77%
油電燃氣業 +1.57%
其中塑膠工業不只漲幅最強，也有 327.24 億資金流入，是今天比較明確的資金亮點。航運業也有 112.83 億流入、上漲 1.53%，顯示資金開始從電子權值，往傳產、航運與低基期族群輪動。

三、族群龍頭：塑膠、航運、金融成為盤面支撐

今天盤面不是全面強，而是「電子熄火、傳產接棒」。
塑膠工業是最明顯的主軸，漲幅達 7.18%，加上資金流入 327.24 億，代表市場資金有往原物料與低基期族群移動。
航運業雖然不是漲幅第一，但資金流入達 112.83 億，而且族群上漲 1.53%，代表資金在大盤失守 4 萬 6 時，仍願意尋找具輪動機會的族群。
金融保險業資金流入 79.99 億，漲幅 0.36%，在權值電子壓盤時，扮演比較穩定的防守角色。
今天的盤面重點可以簡化成一句話：
指數靠電子決定高度，但短線人氣開始往塑膠、航運、金融等族群擴散。

四、從族群資金延伸到贏指標策略觀察

今天贏指標的「偏強機會股」可以搭配資金流向一起看，不是看到名單就追，而是先確認：族群有沒有資金、個股有沒有進入系統偏強訊號。
台塑｜塑膠工業
塑膠是今天最強族群，台塑出現在偏強機會股，代表資金不是只拉小型股，而是連族群核心權值也開始被系統捕捉到。
亞航、龍德造｜航運／軍工題材
航運今天有資金流入，亞航、龍德造同步出現在偏強名單，顯示航運與軍工相關題材仍有資金延伸。
國票金、永豐金、三商壽｜金融族群
金融在大盤震盪時資金仍流入，相關個股進入偏強機會股，代表防守型資金沒有退場。
和成｜玻璃陶瓷／建材題材
玻璃陶瓷今天位居強勢族群前段，和成出現突破 1 日，代表低基期傳產題材也開始被系統篩選出來。
安集、千附｜非權值題材股
電子權值偏弱，但部分非權值題材仍有個股進入偏強策略，顯示電子內部不是全面熄火，而是轉向更挑選個股。
這一段最重要的教學是：
先看大盤贏指標是否守住強弱關鍵，再看資金流向哪個族群，最後才看策略清單中是否有同族群個股出現。
這樣做的好處是，不會只因為某檔股票上漲就追，也不會因為指數收黑就完全忽略輪動機會。

五、今日總結：失守 4 萬 6，但系統還沒翻弱

今天台股雖然跌破 4 萬 6 大關，但贏指標仍維持 突破 11 日，強弱關鍵在 45,185.84 點。只要沒有跌破這個位置，短線仍屬於反彈後的整理，而不是系統全面轉弱。
接下來觀察三件事：
第一，贏指標強弱分界能不能守住。
第二，成交量能不能延續在兆元以上。
今天成交量仍有 1.06 兆，代表市場熱度還在，但如果後續量縮又跌破短均，反彈力道就會降溫。
第三，資金輪動能不能擴散。
塑膠、航運、金融今天接棒，但若電子權值持續疲弱，指數要重新站穩 4 萬 6 仍會有壓力。
所以今天的重點不是「跌 210 點」本身，而是：
指數失守 4 萬 6，但贏指標還在突破狀態；盤勢轉為輪動，接下來看強弱關鍵能不能守住。
