paras_en: August 14, 2026 (Optimal Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) - US President Trump announced that tariffs will be imposed on imported drones and related components, citing that the US currently relies too heavily on overseas suppliers and that some imported products pose national security and supply chain risks.
According to the White House's executive order, a 100% tariff will be imposed on drones and components deemed sensitive to national security, while smaller drones will be subject to a 25% tariff.
Drones and components from the EU, Japan, Liechtenstein, South Korea, Switzerland, and Taiwan will be subject to a 15% tariff, while UK products will be subject to a 10% tariff.

Trump stated that US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick had previously investigated the impact of imported UAS and drones on the US industry and national security. The investigation found that the US drone market has a high import penetration rate and relies too heavily on overseas suppliers.

The White House emphasized that 'the US drone production needs to be expanded rapidly to ensure the US's national security and economic security.' However, according to Bloomberg statistics, DJI Technologies (DJI Technologies), a Shenzhen-based company, accounted for approximately 70% of the US commercial drone market as of last year, and considering other foreign suppliers' market share, the overall import penetration rate of the US commercial drone market is estimated to be above 80-85%.

The US's protectionist policies will reshape the supply chain's geographical distribution, but will not suppress overall demand. Suppliers from allied countries (EU, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan) face a lower 15% tariff and may become the primary beneficiaries of alternative supplies.

items.title: 生成式AI上市大戰開打！OpenAI年化營收破400億美元 迎戰強敵Anthropic
items.title_en: Generative AI IPO Battle Heats Up: OpenAI's Annual Revenue Surpasses $40 Billion, Challenging Anthropic
paras: 知情人士透露，從目前的營運表現推測，OpenAI的營收年化預估值(run rate)即將突破400億美元，與2025年底相比已成長一倍，這有助於OpenAI正在籌備的首次公開發行(IPO)，也凸顯其與Anthropic之間日益激烈的商業競爭。
彭博引述的知情人士說，OpenAI近幾個月以來的營收加速成長，原因包括訂閱銷售需求強勁、廣告業務開始展露頭角，以及專業軟體產品持續成長，尤其是Codex程式碼代理工具，以及針對企業用戶的ChatGPT Work應用程式。此外，核心的消費性業務也繼續成長。
OpenAI正與Anthropic展開激烈的競爭。Anthropic也在加速拓展企業市場，目前已秘密提交上市文件，最快可能搶先OpenAI一步，在今年秋季公開上市。
Anthropic在5月公布的營收年化預估值達470億美元，但由於由於兩家私人新創公司的會計方法不同，不適合直接比較。
為了抵禦國內競爭對手、以及中國低成本競爭者對市占率的威脅，OpenAI積極調整市場拓展及定價策略，例如近期降低部分AI模型的價格，以吸引對成本較為敏感的開發者。
OpenAI最近時也延攬一名資深網路安全高層擔任第二位營收長(CRO)，以強化企業銷售業務，這是OpenAI不到一年內第二度更換營收長。
先前的商業拓展努力似乎開始浮現成果，OpenAI共同創辦人暨總裁Greg Brockman在內部公告中告知員工，光是7月一個月的營收就增加逾20%。
OpenAI在這波大幅成長之前，已經歷一段快速擴張期。OpenAI財務長Sarah Friar此前曾表示，去年底的營收年化預估值已突破200億美元。
paras_en: Sources close to the matter reveal that OpenAI's annual revenue run rate is expected to surpass $40 billion, more than doubling from the end of 2025, which will help the company's initial public offering (IPO) and highlight its intensifying commercial competition with Anthropic.

According to sources cited by Bloomberg, OpenAI's revenue growth has accelerated over the past few months, driven by strong demand for subscription sales, the emergence of advertising business, and the continued growth of professional software products, particularly the Codex code proxy tool and the ChatGPT Work application for corporate users. Additionally, the core consumer business has continued to grow.

OpenAI is engaged in a fierce competition with Anthropic. Anthropic is also accelerating its expansion into the corporate market and has secretly submitted its IPO filing, potentially beating OpenAI to the market and going public as early as this fall.
Anthropic reported an annual revenue run rate of $47 billion in May, but due to differences in accounting methods between the two private startups, the figures are not directly comparable.

To counter domestic competitors and the threat of Chinese low-cost competitors to market share, OpenAI is actively adjusting its market expansion and pricing strategies, including recent price reductions for some AI models to attract developers sensitive to costs.

OpenAI has also recently hired a seasoned network security executive as its second chief revenue officer (CRO) to strengthen its enterprise sales business, which is the company's second CRO change in less than a year.

Previous business expansion efforts seem to be bearing fruit, with OpenAI co-founder and CEO Greg Brockman informing employees in an internal announcement that the company's revenue increased by over 20% in July alone.

Before this significant growth, OpenAI had experienced a period of rapid expansion. OpenAI's CFO Sarah Friar previously stated that the company's annual revenue run rate had surpassed $20 billion at the end of last year.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】英國GDP彈升，提供英鎊支撐
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: UK GDP Surge Provides Pound Support

美國7月消費者物價指數(CPI)漲幅溫和，削弱美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)下月升息的理由，並據芝加哥商品交易所(CME)的FedWatch工具顯示，貨幣市場預計FED在9月加息的概率跌至34%，同時美國和伊朗和平的努力停滯料影響需求，導致油價走低，令美元承壓；此外，週四日本央行(BOJ)數據顯示，7月國內企業物價指數(CGPI)分別較前月與上年同期升0.1%及7.2%不及預期，但升幅居高不下，表明通貨膨脹壓力擴大，強化市場對BOJ在9月升息的臆測，而且彭博新聞援引知情人士的話報導，日本首相高市早苗政府支持近期加息，反映美國財政部長貝森特在聯合干預後敦促日本採取政策和基本面措施，暗示其收歛鴿派立場及允許BOJ升息，日本公債與美國公債收益率差將進一步縮窄，提供日圓支撐。

items.title: 挪威央行維持利率4.25%不變 通膨風險與地緣政治仍令政策前景蒙陰
items.title_en: Norway Central Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 4.25% as Inflation and Geopolitical Risks Loom
paras: 挪威央行周四(13日)宣布將基準利率維持在 4.25% 保持不變，此一決定完全符合市場預期，媒體對 16 位分析師進行的調查均準確預測了此結果。
儘管通膨壓力近期有所緩解，但委員會認為仍需維持緊縮的貨幣政策，以確保通膨能在合理時間內回落至目標水準。
挪威央行總裁巴克(Ida Wolden Bache)在聲明中指出，今年夏季的通膨數據低於預期，這是一個令人欣慰的消息，但目前的通膨率依然過高。她強調，現在得出通膨前景已發生實質性變化的結論還為時過早，因此「未來仍有必要提高政策利率」。
雖然挪威近兩個月的核心物價增長出人意料地溫和，讓官員有空間觀察這座能源資源豐富的經濟體是否正在降溫，但推動國內物價的關鍵因素——包括強勁的薪資增長與緊繃的勞動力市場——依然穩固。此外，央行特別提到，中東地區的持續衝突也為全球通膨前景增加了不確定性。
在利率決議公布後，挪威克朗兌歐元匯率小幅走弱 0.2% 至 10.9684。分析師對於 9 月是否會進行最後一次升息看法分歧。丹麥銀行(Danske Bank)首席經濟學家 Jullum 認為，8 月的核心通膨可能再次攀升至 3% 以上，這將迫使央行在 9 月採取行動，儘管這將是一個「艱難的抉擇」。目前交易員預計 9 月升息的可能性已從先前的預期略微下修。
挪威央行預計將在 9 月發布新的通膨預測與政策路徑報告，屆時將提供更多關於利率走向的明確指引。
paras_en: The Norwegian central bank announced on Thursday (13th) that it would maintain the benchmark interest rate at 4.25% unchanged, a decision that fully met market expectations, with all 16 analysts surveyed by the media accurately predicting the outcome.

Although inflationary pressures have eased in recent periods, the committee believes that it is still necessary to maintain a tight monetary policy to ensure that inflation returns to its target level in a reasonable time.

Norwegian Central Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache stated in a statement that the summer inflation data were lower than expected, which is a welcome news, but the current inflation rate is still too high. She emphasized that it is too early to conclude that the inflation outlook has undergone a substantial change, and therefore, "it is still necessary to raise policy interest rates in the future."

Although Norway's core inflation rate has been unexpectedly mild over the past two months, giving officials some room to observe whether the economy is cooling down, the key drivers of domestic prices, including strong wage growth and a tight labor market, remain solid. In addition, the central bank specifically mentioned that the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have increased uncertainty about the global inflation outlook.

After the interest rate decision was announced, the Norwegian krone depreciated against the euro by 0.2% to 10.9684. Analysts are divided on whether there will be a final rate hike in September. Danske Bank Chief Economist Jullum believes that the core inflation rate may rise again to above 3% in August, which would force the central bank to take action in September, although this would be a "difficult choice." Currently, traders have slightly reduced their expectations for a rate hike in September.
The Norwegian central bank plans to release new inflation forecasts and policy path reports in September, which will provide more explicit guidance on the direction of interest rates.

items.title: 日元走強 高市早苗政府傳支持近期升息
items.title_en: Yen Rises as Kishida Government Said to Support Near-Term Rate Hike
paras: 據知情人士透露，日本首相高市早苗領導的政府目前正轉向支持日本央行(BOJ)於近期升息，預計下一次調升利率的時機最快將落在今年 9 月或 10 月。
這項立場轉變的核心考量在於，日元持續疲軟已推高進口物價並加劇生活成本危機，政府希望透過貨幣政策的配合，強化美日聯合匯率干預的效果。
此消息對市場產生即時衝擊，日元兌美元匯率一度從 159.46 走強至 159.18 附近，日本國債期貨則隨之下跌，基準 10 年期國債殖利率微幅上升。市場目前正密切關注 9 月 18 日的政策會議，交易員預期屆時升息的機率已高達 74%。
高市早苗過去一向被視為對快速升息持保留態度，擔心過早收緊貨幣會扼殺經濟復甦，但在日元貶值引發選民不滿的背景下，政府內部對緊縮政策的容忍度顯著提高。若央行在 12 個月內完成第三次升息，將創下自 1989 年資產泡沫巔峰以來最快的緊縮步調。
雖然日本政府強調尊重央行的法律獨立性，但雙方需就經濟目標保持密切聯繫。日本央行總裁植田和男此前已暗示，面對物價上行的風險，不排除加快升息步伐。
此外，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也曾表示，日本央行有必要加入支撐日元的行動。在政府與央行 2013 年簽署的共同協議框架下，雙方正朝著穩定實現 2% 通膨目標的方向協作，這也為近期的政策轉向奠定了政治基礎。
paras_en: According to informed sources, the government led by Japanese Prime Minister Kishida Fumio is now shifting towards supporting the Bank of Japan (BOJ) in raising interest rates in the near term, with the next rate hike expected to occur as early as September or October this year.

The core consideration behind this shift in stance is that the prolonged weakness of the yen has driven up import prices and exacerbated the cost-of-living crisis, and the government hopes to enhance the effectiveness of joint US-Japan currency intervention through monetary policy coordination.

This news has had an immediate impact on the market, with the yen strengthening against the US dollar from 159.46 to around 159.18, and Japanese government bond futures falling, with the benchmark 10-year bond yield rising slightly. The market is closely watching the policy meeting on September 18, with traders expecting a 74% chance of a rate hike at that time.

Kishida Fumio has been seen as cautious about rapid rate hikes in the past, fearing that premature tightening of monetary policy could stifle economic recovery, but in the context of the yen's depreciation triggering voter discontent, the government's tolerance for tightening policies has increased significantly. If the central bank completes its third rate hike within 12 months, it will be the fastest tightening pace since the peak of the asset bubble in 1989.

Although the Japanese government emphasizes respect for the central bank's legal independence, the two sides need to maintain close contact on economic targets. BOJ Governor Ueda Kazuo has previously hinted that, faced with the risk of rising prices, he does not rule out accelerating the pace of rate hikes.

Additionally, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has also stated that the Bank of Japan needs to join in supporting the yen. Under the joint agreement framework signed by the government and the central bank in 2013, both sides are working together to achieve the 2% inflation target, which has also laid the political foundation for the recent policy shift.

items.title: 美國干預日元反而更危險？《財富》警告市場恐被「大玩家」綁架
items.title_en: Is U.S. Intervention in the Yen More Dangerous? Fortune Warns the Market May Be Hijacked by a “Big Player”
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）與日本財務省聯手干預外匯市場，試圖推動日元升至他眼中「更合理」的水準。然而，這場看似為穩定匯市而來的行動，可能反而釋放出更危險的訊號：當市場開始揣摩政策官員的一言一行，而非依循經濟基本面定價，匯市波動恐怕不減反增。
貝森特先前接受福斯財經網（Fox Business）訪問時直言，日元遭到「嚴重低估」，並認為貨幣「過度波動」並不健康，等同公開質疑市場形成的日元價格。隨著貝森特與日本財務省採取行動，日元隨即走強，但這波升勢究竟能否持續，仍有待觀察。
「大玩家」進場 市場定價邏輯生變
日元走強有兩項主要原因。首先是相關機構直接買進日元；其次，也是影響更大的因素，是貝森特與日本財務大臣片山皋月透過公開發言向市場施壓。兩人均明確表態希望日元升值，並準備透過干預措施支撐疲弱的日元。
《財富》分析指出，這種足以透過言論與行動改變市場走勢的政策人物，是市場中的「大玩家」。「大玩家」最大的特徵，在於其決策不必遵循簡單、明確的規則，而是高度依賴個人判斷。當市場無法預測其下一步行動，政策干預本身就可能成為新的不確定性來源。
歷史教訓：干預可能放大波動
以19世紀俄羅斯的經驗為例。1887年，維什涅格拉茨基（Ivan Vyshnegradsky）出任沙俄財政大臣後，積極操縱盧布兌德國馬克匯率，其干預最終加劇市場波動。繼任者維特（Sergei Witte）則改變方向，放棄裁量式干預，並於1897年推動盧布錨定金本位制。
相關央行干預研究顯示，捍衛貨幣升值與刻意拉高匯率，兩者效果並不相同；相較之下，以明確規則為基礎的制度能降低這類不對稱風險。
換言之，規則提供市場可預測性，而「大玩家」式的裁量干預，反而可能放大波動。
「財政部觀察」恐取代基本面
真正值得警惕的，是貝森特成為外匯市場「大玩家」後可能帶來的連鎖效應。《財富》認為，市場未來可能催生新的「財政部觀察」模式，交易員將緊盯貝森特的每一次發言，逐字解讀他的評論，甚至追逐未經證實的政策傳聞。
一旦這種交易模式形成，真正左右匯率的可能不再只是經濟基本面，而是市場對貝森特下一步行動的猜測，以及對其他交易員猜測的再猜測。
《財富》警告，這將助長羊群效應與噪音交易，使市場參與者把更多精力投入預測政策人物的態度變化，而非分析基本面。
因此，貝森特干預日元真正危險之處，或許不只是日元究竟應該升到什麼價位，而是市場定價機制本身可能發生改變。當交易員開始追逐「大玩家」的一舉一動，政策原本試圖壓低的波動，反而可能因此被進一步放大。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, working together with Japan’s Ministry of Finance, intervened in the foreign‑exchange market in an effort to push the yen up to what he sees as a more reasonable level. Yet this action, which appears aimed at stabilising the market, may actually send a more dangerous signal: when the market starts to read every word and move of policy officials instead of pricing based on economic fundamentals, currency volatility could increase rather than decrease.

In a prior interview with Fox Business, Bessent bluntly said the yen was "severely undervalued" and that its "excessive volatility" was unhealthy, essentially questioning the market‑determined price of the yen. After Bessent and the Japanese finance ministry took action, the yen immediately appreciated, but whether this rally can be sustained remains to be seen.
“Big Player” Enters, Changing Market‑Pricing Logic

The yen’s strength stems from two main drivers. First, the relevant authorities are directly buying yen. Second, and more impactful, is the pressure Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki apply to the market through public statements. Both have made it clear they want a stronger yen and are prepared to back a weak yen with intervention measures.

Fortune’s analysis points out that policy figures capable of moving markets through words and deeds are the market’s “big players.” The hallmark of a big player is that their decisions do not follow simple, transparent rules but rely heavily on personal judgment. When the market cannot predict their next move, the intervention itself becomes a new source of uncertainty.
Historical Lesson: Intervention Can Amplify Volatility

Take 19th‑century Russia as an example. In 1887, Ivan Vyshnegradsky, as finance minister of the Tsarist regime, actively manipulated the ruble‑to‑German‑mark exchange rate, and his interventions ultimately heightened market volatility. His successor, Sergei Witte, changed course, abandoning discretionary intervention and, in 1897, anchoring the ruble to the gold standard.

Research on central‑bank interventions shows that defending a currency’s appreciation and deliberately pushing a rate higher produce different outcomes; by contrast, rule‑based systems can reduce such asymmetric risks.
In other words, rules give the market predictability, whereas discretionary “big‑player” interventions may actually magnify volatility.
“Treasury Watch” May Supplant Fundamentals

The real danger lies in the chain reaction that could follow Bessent’s emergence as a foreign‑exchange “big player.” Fortune believes the market may give rise to a new “Treasury Watch” paradigm, where traders obsess over every utterance from Bessent, parsing his comments word‑by‑word and even chasing unverified policy rumours.

If such a trading style takes hold, the forces truly moving exchange rates may no longer be economic fundamentals but speculation about Bessent’s next step and the subsequent guesses of other traders about those guesses.

Fortune warns this will fuel herd behaviour and noise trading, causing market participants to devote more energy to forecasting the attitude shifts of policy figures rather than analysing fundamentals.

Thus, the real danger of Bessent’s yen intervention may not be the specific level to which the yen should rise, but the potential alteration of the market‑pricing mechanism itself. When traders start chasing every move of the “big player,” the volatility that policy originally sought to suppress could be amplified further.

隨後美國公布7月消費者物價指數(CPI)分別較前月與上年同期漲0.1%及3.4%符合預期，但扣除食品和能源成分的核心CPI較去年同期降至2.5%，通貨膨脹連續兩個月降溫，促使芝加哥商品交易所(CME)的FedWatch工具顯示FED在9月15-16日會議升息的機率跌至38%，打擊美元兌日圓至158.67低點。隨著英國金融時報報導，美國波士頓聯邦儲備銀行柯林斯表示若通貨膨脹率居高不下，支持FED在9月加息，而且細項數據來看，美國通貨膨脹壓力有擴散跡象及FED青睞的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指標料仍維持3%，推升美元兌日圓至159.54高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於158.80-159.00，阻力於159.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)維持利率在4.35%不變，但總裁布洛克在新聞發布會上釋放更鷹派訊號表示，若通貨膨脹未能如預期般回落，完全有可能再升息，突顯10月底公布第三季CPI數據的重要性，而且市場預計FED於9月加息的概率約50%，相對RBA於11月再收緊貨幣政策的可能性大致相當，昨日支撐澳幣和紐元，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1562高點。

◆GBP/USD

週三英國首相伯納姆接受英國廣播公司(BBC)電台採訪表示，儘管財政前景艱難，政府仍將盡力幫助企業降低成本，而且英國經濟尚未疲軟到足以平息英國央行(BOE)進一步加息的爭論，並因財政不確定性導致英國公債收益率期限溢價維持近二十年最高水平附近，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3541高點。隨著美國7月CPI符合預期，推遲FED可能加息的時間，但數據公布前市場大舉作多美元，而且中東局勢持續緊張及油價上漲支撐美元，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3484低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3500-20，支撐於1.3410-30。
